findings.description: StablePairHook (src/stable/StablePairHook.sol#25-259) declares permission `beforeInitialize` (bit 13, BEFORE_INITIALIZE_FLAG) but provides no working `beforeInitialize` implementation. The PoolManager will call it on every matching pool operation and the call will revert, making the pool unusable for that operation.
evidence: StablePairHook (src/stable/StablePairHook.sol#25-259) declares permission `beforeInitialize` (bit 13, BEFORE_INITIALIZE_FLAG) but provides no working `beforeInitialize` implementation. The PoolManager will call it on every matching pool operation and the call will revert, making the pool unusable for that operation.

StablePairHook (src/stable/StablePairHook.sol#25-259) declares permission `afterInitialize` (bit 12, AFTER_INITIALIZE_FLAG) but provides no working `afterInitialize` implementation. The PoolManager will call it on every matching pool operation and the call will revert, making the pool unusable for that operation.
